fullText.simplified:
第十一章、谁偷走了北极熊

    孙林的脑袋里有一个大大的问号，他问江易：“你刚才说自然博物馆的那只北极熊标本不是你偷的？”
    江易说：“是的，不是我偷走的。”
    孙林挑了下眉毛，问道：“那博物馆的北极熊呢？去哪儿了？”
    江易说：“我不知道那只北极熊去哪儿了，但我知道那里面装的是黄金。”
    孙林连忙问道：“你怎么知道的？”
    “我女朋友说的。”江易说，“他们的标本都是有标记的。标本上有黄色标记的里面装的是黄金，标本上有白色标记的里面装的是毒品。那只北极熊标本的手上有一个黄色的圆圆的标记。”
    孙林思考了一下，说：“你的意思是，有人偷走了那只北极熊标本，其实他想偷的是里面的黄金？”
    江易说：“我不知道他想偷什么，但是黄金丢了，王石差点儿气死。他调查了很久，也没有找到小偷是谁。他一直在为这事发愁，而且他们一直有一个疑问：因为装了黄金，那只北极熊标本非常重，非常非常重，没有五六个人是根本不可能拿走的，所以小偷是如何同时拿走北极熊和黄金的呢？”
    他们还想继续说下去，但是外面警车的声音打断了他们的对话。这时候季平站了起来，慢慢地说道：“江易，首先我要谢谢你，你是一个好人。警察现在已经去了思南路的酒吧和KTV，他们也会去博物馆。不出意外的话，你的女朋友会被抓，毕竟她做了错事。其实我已经调查王石很久了，但是之前我证据不够，现在我希望你和你的女朋友可以帮我。王石伤害了那么多人，我们一起撕下他的面具，让所有人看看真实的他到底是个什么样的人。”
    江易听完，犹豫了一下，但最后他认真地点了点头，答应了季平。
    处理完这些事情，季平准备和孙林去喝一杯。孙林在路上一直都沉默着，一句话也没有说，似乎在为什么事发愁。
    季平看出来了，他拍了拍孙林的肩膀，开口问道：“孙林，你是不是还有什么疑问啊？”
    孙林问道：“季平先生，您早就知道王石不是好人，对吗？”
    季平说：“一个人面兽心的人。”
    孙林又问：“您也早就知道江易是个好人，对吗？”
    季平说：“一个兽面人心的人。”
    “果然是这样。”孙林看着季平，说道：“季平先生，您太厉害了！您怎么什么都知道？”
    季平充满了笑意，说：“哈哈，可能因为我是季平吧。”
    孙林看了看季平，小声地问道：“那博物馆那只北极熊标本呢？是您偷走的吗？”
    季平微笑着，似乎有什么话要说。

第十一章、誰偷走了北極熊

    孫林的腦袋裡有一個大大的問號，他問江易：“你剛才說自然博物館的那隻北極熊標本不是你偷的？”
    江易說：“是的，不是我偷走的。”
    孫林挑了下眉毛，問道：“那博物館的北極熊呢？去哪兒了？”
    江易說：“我不知道那隻北極熊去哪兒了，但我知道那裡面裝的是黃金。”
    孫林連忙問道：“你怎麼知道的？”
    “我女朋友說的。”江易說，“他們的標本都是有標記的。標本上有黃色標記的裡面裝的是黃金，標本上有白色標記的裡面裝的是毒品。那隻北極熊標本的手上有一個黃色的圓圓的標記。”
    孫林思考了一下，說：“你的意思是，有人偷走了那隻北極熊標本，其實他想偷的是裡面的黃金？”
    江易說：“我不知道他想偷什麼，但是黃金丟了，王石差點兒氣死。他調查了很久，也沒有找到小偷是誰。他一直在為這事發愁，而且他們一直有一個疑問：因為裝了黃金，那隻北極熊標本非常重，非常非常重，沒有五六個人是根本不可能拿走的，所以小偷是如何同時拿走北極熊和黃金的呢？”
    他們還想繼續說下去，但是外面警車的聲音打斷了他們的對話。這時候季平站了起來，慢慢地說道：“江易，首先我要謝謝你，你是一個好人。警察現在已經去了思南路的酒吧和KTV，他們也會去博物館。不出意外的話，你的女朋友會被抓，畢竟她做了錯事。其實我已經調查王石很久了，但是之前我證據不夠，現在我希望你和你的女朋友可以幫我。王石傷害了那麼多人，我們一起撕下他的面具，讓所有人看看真實的他到底是個什麼樣的人。”
    江易聽完，猶豫了一下，但最後他認真地點了點頭，答應了季平。
    處理完這些事情，季平準備和孫林去喝一杯。孫林在路上一直都沉默著，一句話也沒有說，似乎在為什麼事發愁。
    季平看出來了，他拍了拍孫林的肩膀，開口問道：“孫林，你是不是還有什麼疑問啊？”
    孫林問道：“季平先生，您早就知道王石不是好人，對嗎？”
    季平說：“一個人面獸心的人。”
    孫林又問：“您也早就知道江易是個好人，對嗎？”
    季平說：“一個獸面人心的人。”
    “果然是這樣。”孫林看著季平，說道：“季平先生，您太厲害了！您怎麼什麼都知道？”
    季平充滿了笑意，說：“哈哈，可能因為我是季平吧。”
    孫林看了看季平，小聲地問道：“那博物館那隻北極熊標本呢？是您偷走的嗎？”
    季平微笑著，似乎有什麼話要說。

sentences.simplified: “果然是这样。”孙林看着季平，说道：“季平先生，您太厉害了！您怎么什么都知道？”
sentences.traditional: “果然是這樣。”孫林看著季平，說道：“季平先生，您太厲害了！您怎麼什麼都知道？”
sentences.pinyin: guǒ rán shì zhè yàng sūn lín kàn zhe jì píng shuō dào jì píng xiān sheng nín tài lì hai le nín zěn me shén me dōu zhī dào
sentences.english: “As I expected.” Sun Lin looked at Mr. Ji Ping and said, “Mr. Ji Ping, you’re incredible! How do you know all this?”

sentences.simplified: 季平充满了笑意，说：“哈哈，可能因为我是季平吧。”
sentences.traditional: 季平充滿了笑意，說：“哈哈，可能因為我是季平吧。”
sentences.pinyin: jì píng chōng mǎn le xiào yì shuō hā hā kě néng yīn wèi wǒ shì jì píng ba
sentences.english: Ji Ping was full of smiles and said, “Haha, maybe it’s because I’m Ji Ping.”

sentences.simplified: 孙林看了看季平，小声地问道：“那博物馆那只北极熊标本呢？是您偷走的吗？”
sentences.traditional: 孫林看了看季平，小聲地問道：“那博物館那隻北極熊標本呢？是您偷走的嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: sūn lín kàn le kàn jì píng xiǎo shēng de wèn dào nà bó wù guǎn nà zhī běi jí xióng biāo běn ne shì nín tōu zǒu de ma
sentences.english: Sun Lin looked at Ji Ping and asked in a low voice, “What about that polar bear specimen at the museum? Was it you who stole it?”

sentences.simplified: 季平微笑着，似乎有什么话要说。
sentences.traditional: 季平微笑著，似乎有什麼話要說。
sentences.pinyin: jì píng wēi xiào zhe sì hū yǒu shén me huà yào shuō
sentences.english: Ji Ping smiled as if he had something to say.

sentence_translations: Chapter 11: Who Stole the Polar Bear?
There was a big question mark in Sun Lin’s mind, and he asked Jiang Yi, ..
.. “Did you just say that you didn’t steal the polar bear specimen from the Natural History Museum?”
Jiang Yi said, “Yes. I didn’t steal it.”
Sun Lin raised his eyebrows and asked, “Then, what about the polar bear in the museum? Where did it go?”
Jiang Yi said, “I don’t know where that polar bear went. But I know that it had gold inside.”
Sun Lin asked at once, “How do you know that?”
“My girlfriend said so,” Jiang Yi said, “Their specimens were all marked.
The specimens with a yellow mark had gold in them, and the specimens with a white mark had drugs in them.
The paw of that polar bear specimen had a round yellow mark.”
Sun Lin pondered for a moment and said, ..
.. “You mean that when someone stole that polar bear specimen, in fact, what he wanted to steal was the gold inside?”
Jiang Yi said, “I don’t know what he wanted to steal. But when the gold was lost, Wang Shi was extremely angry.
He investigated it for a long time, but he couldn’t find out who the thief was.
He worried about this all the time, and they always questioned something:
Since there was gold inside it, the polar bear specimen was extremely heavy. Extremely, extremely heavy.
It would need at least five to six people to take it away, so how did the thief take both the polar bear and the gold at the same time?”
They wanted to keep talking, but they were interrupted by the sound of a police car outside.
At this point, Ji Ping stood up and said slowly, “Jiang Yi, first I want to thank you. You are a good person.
The police have now gone to the bar and KTV on Sinan Road. They have also gone to the museum.
Unless something goes wrong, your girlfriend will be arrested. After all, she did something wrong.
In fact, I have been investigating Wang Shi for a long time, but previously I didn’t have enough evidence.
Now I hope that you and your girlfriend can help me.
Wang Shi has hurt so many people. Let’s tear off his mask together and let everyone see what kind of person he really is.”
Jiang Yi hesitated for a while after hearing this, but in the end, he nodded earnestly and agreed to help Ji Ping.
After taking care of these things, Ji Ping was ready to go for a drink with Sun Lin.
Sun Lin was silent the whole way and did not say a word. He seemed to be worried about something.
Ji Ping could see that, so he patted Sun Lin’s shoulder and opened his mouth to ask, “Sun Lin, do you still have some questions?
Sun Lin asked, “Mr. Ji Ping, you have known for a long time that Wang Shi is not a good person, right?”
Ji Ping said, “A man with a human face and a beast’s heart.”
Sun Lin asked again, “You have also known for a long time that Jiang Yi is a good person, right?”
Ji Ping said, “A man with a beast’s face and a human heart.”
“As I expected.” Sun Lin looked at Mr. Ji Ping and said, “Mr. Ji Ping, you’re incredible! How do you know all this?”
Ji Ping was full of smiles and said, “Haha, maybe it’s because I’m Ji Ping.”
Sun Lin looked at Ji Ping and asked in a low voice, “What about that polar bear specimen at the museum? Was it you who stole it?”
Ji Ping smiled as if he had something to say.
